info.name: DAturUpanandinIwippaRI
info.value: saNkocaH hrasvIBavanam . prAyeRa sampUrvaka eva ayaM prayujyate . ' saNkoce kucatIti syAt kAcet samparcanAdizu ' (Slo. 54) iti devaH .

examples: 'na me manaH saNkucati pradAnAt' (avadA॰SrezWi॰12). pradAne na vicArayati.
'na Srutena na dAnena na sAntvena na cejyayA. tvayeyaM pfTivI labDA na saNkocena cApyuta' (BA॰SAM॰14.18)..
'na hi saNkucitaH panTA yena vAlI hato gataH. samaye tizWa sugrIva mA vAlipaTamanvagAH' (rA॰4.30.20).. saNkucitaH=saMvftaH=nirudDaH.

examples.text: sasAda ca kapiH kawyAM caraRO saYcukoca ca
